## Setup the environment 

Install all libraries 

<div class="tip">
  <strong>💡 Tip:</strong> Execute this step only one time..
</div>

```{r,echo = T, eval = T, include=TRUE, width = "100%", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 📦 Install Required Packages
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────

# CRAN packages
cran_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "readr", "ggpubr", "RColorBrewer",
  "pheatmap", "factoextra", "knitr", "kableExtra", "plotly"

)

# Bioconductor packages
bioc_packages <- c(
  "DESeq2", "AnnotationDbi", "org.Mm.eg.db",
  "msigdbr", "fgsea", "clusterProfiler", "DOSE", "europepmc",
  "enrichplot"
)

# Install CRAN packages if missing
install_if_missing <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

invisible(lapply(cran_packages, install_if_missing))

# Install BiocManager if not present
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

# Install Bioconductor packages if missing
install_bioc_if_missing <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(pkg)
  }
}

invisible(lapply(bioc_packages, install_bioc_if_missing))

# extra
#if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# ✅ Done! You're ready to go.
```

<div class="remember">
  <strong>📌 Remember:</strong> Load all the libraries before starting the tutorial.
</div>

```{r,echo = T, eval = T, include=TRUE, width = "100%", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 📦 Data Handling & Wrangling
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)    # Collection of R packages for data science (ggplot2, dplyr, etc.)
library(readr)        # Fast and friendly functions to read rectangular data

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🧬 Differential Expression Analysis
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(DESeq2)       # Core package for RNA-seq differential analysis

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🎨 Plotting & Visualization
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggpubr)       # Publication-ready plots built on ggplot2
library(RColorBrewer) # Color palettes for maps and heatmaps
library(pheatmap)     # Pretty heatmaps
library(factoextra)   # Visualization tools for multivariate data (e.g., PCA)
#library(EnhancedVolcano) # Easy and elegant volcano plots
library("plotly")
library(enrichplot)   # Visualization of enrichment results

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 📊 Tables & Reporting
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(knitr)        # Dynamic report generation
library(kableExtra)   # Beautiful tables with kable()

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 🔍 Annotation & Enrichment Analysis
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(AnnotationDbi)    # Interface to Bioconductor annotation databases
library(org.Mm.eg.db)     # Annotation database for *Mus musculus* (mouse)
library(msigdbr)          # MSigDB gene sets in tidy format
library(fgsea)            # Fast implementation of Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)
library(clusterProfiler)  # Universal enrichment tool
library(DOSE)             # Disease Ontology enrichment analysis
library(europepmc)        # Query Europe PMC database (for literature mining)
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────
```
